In Chilliwack Proper East, the 55+ homes you can buy are Mountainview Estates (strata). The other seniors housing here, which you cannot buy into, is retirement residence or care. This page names each building, says what type it is and what the sources show, and covers local rules and the questions buyers ask. Anything no source states is marked unconfirmed.
55+ strata buildings you can buy in Chilliwack Proper East
Mountainview Estates — 46966 Yale Road (board label: Chilliwack Proper East)

55+ freehold strata building; listing headlines record "IMMACULATE 55+ Mountainview Estates" and no pets, and a building directory records age restrictions in its bylaws. CONFLICT, flagged: built 1989 in listings, 1988 in the building directory — no year is settled here. The directory's older "rentals not allowed" line is overridden by provincial law —. Confirm the age bylaw against the registered bylaws and Form B before relying on it.
Rental, care and subsidized seniors housing in Chilliwack Proper East (not for sale)

items.t: The Cascades — 45586 McIntosh Drive: Registered in BC's Assisted Living Registry, operator Sienna-Baltic (Cascades) Inc., class SN — an assisted-living residence in the hospital precinct. BOUNDARY FLAG: whether McIntosh Drive falls inside the Proper East scope or the Proper West scope is a boundary question the sources do not settle — it is carried here because the hospital precinct is this scope's western edge, and it is flagged, not resolved. Care housing — you cannot buy in.

blocks.text: Streets, schools and getting around Chilliwack Proper East

items.t: Chilliwack is a Chilliwack and District Real Estate Board (CADREB) market, not a Fraser Valley or Greater Vancouver board market; CADREB publishes statistics board-wide only, with no sub-area tables, and SnapStats does not cover Chilliwack — so no market figures are stated for this area in this file: UNVERIFIED, and no other board's figures are substituted.

Municipality: City of Chilliwack, BC. The current city-wide plan is the Chilliwack 2050 Official Community Plan, Bylaw 2025, No. 5500, and Schedule B2 — the Chilliwack Proper and Fairfield Island Neighbourhoods Plan — is the neighbourhood plan that covers this ground.

Working corridors, from the live page: Yale Road, Williams Street, Prest Road, First Avenue and Broadway Street. The page's first-page feed mixes detached houses (ranchers and older houses on full-size lots, including on McNaught Road, First Avenue and Second Avenue), a townhouse unit on Hazel Street, a half-duplex with a basement suite on James Street, a bungalow on Cleveland Avenue, and land listings — houses, strata units and vacant lots in one feed. Treat the corridors as the page's working scope only.

Anchor institution: Chilliwack General Hospital, 45600 Menholm Road, west of this sub-area in the city-proper core — Fraser Health describes it as a community hospital providing primary, core secondary and some specialty services. The one registered assisted-living residence named in sits in the hospital precinct, on this scope's western edge.
Catchments are address-based — the district directs families to its School Locator — and no locator result was run for a Proper East address in this research: address-level catchments UNVERIFIED.

Transit: BC Transit's service-improvements notice effective January 4, 2026 records that Route 57 Broadway service on Carleton Street shifts one block east to McNaught Road, with new bus stops on McNaught and Acorn — two streets inside this sub-area's feed — and that additional Sunday-evening service was added for Route 57 Broadway, Route 53 Fairfield and Route 51. Route 66 Fraser Valley Express serves Chilliwack, Abbotsford, Langley and Burnaby with daily service.

Agriculture context for this sub-area's eastern edge: the City states agriculture accounts for 67% of the City's total land base and 29% of economic activity; ALR status for any specific parcel is a parcel-by-parcel check.

Where Chilliwack's other verified 55+ housing sits, for contrast: the Spadina Avenue pair downtown / Proper West side, Knight Lodge and Cottage Grove on the Sardis side, and Cottonwood Village park on Evans Road — all outside this scope, listed at the end of so they are not mistaken for Proper East stock.

blocks.text: Local rules and plans in Chilliwack Proper East

items.t: City zoning: Zoning Bylaw 2020, No. 5000: is Chilliwack's zoning bylaw. Its defines a secondary suite as an accessory dwelling unit of not more than 90 m² and less than 40% of the habitable floor space of the building, located within a building containing only 1 principal dwelling unit — the cap is the lesser of 90 m² and 40%.

Accessory dwelling units: Section 4.06(1) of the same bylaw permits only 1 ADU per lot where the zone permits an ADU; the listed types are secondary suite, coach house and garden suite, garden suites are capped at a maximum gross floor area of 100 m² by Section 4.06(1)(g), and ADU parking is set at s.5.04 (1 space for a 1-bedroom ADU or any secondary suite; 2 spaces for a 2-or-more-bedroom coach or garden suite).

Suite legality: no secondary suite is legal unless built with a building permit meeting the BC Building and Fire Code and current flood protection requirements, and new suites are not permitted below the flood construction level.

SSMUH: Zoning Bylaw Amendment Bylaw 2024, No. 5395 is the City's small-scale multi-unit housing amendment to Bylaw No. 5000, allowing 3 to 4 dwelling units on parcels within the urban growth boundary zoned for single-detached and duplex housing; Bylaw 5395 was adopted June 18, 2024.

City plan: Chilliwack 2050 Official Community Plan, Bylaw 2025, No. 5500: is the current city-wide plan; its Schedule D development permit areas run D-1 Drinking Water Supply through D-10 Industrial, and which areas apply to a given Proper East parcel is a per-parcel check: UNVERIFIED for any specific parcel.

ALR housing frame, for parcels at this sub-area's eastern edge: ALR parcels follow the ALC housing frame of one principal residence at a maximum of 500 m² plus at most one additional residence of 90 m² (parcels ≤40 ha) or 186 m² (parcels >40 ha). ALR status itself is a parcel-by-parcel check.

Property taxes: City of Chilliwack property tax notices are mailed annually at the end of May and are due the first working day after July 1 of every calendar year; a 5% late payment penalty is applied for taxes outstanding after July 2, 2026 and an additional 5% for taxes outstanding after August 4, 2026.

blocks.text: Good to know about Chilliwack Proper East

items.t: Two near-identical building names sit in this one sub-area, and they are not the same product on paper. Mountainview Estates (46966 Yale Rd) is the verified 55+ building; Mountview Apartments (46374 Margaret Ave) carries listing and directory language pointing the same way, but without a bylaws/Form B check it stays a flagged conflict in this file. A buyer searching by name alone can easily pull documents for the wrong building.

Both Proper East buildings carry a built-year conflict between their own sources. Mountainview Estates: 1989 in listings, 1988 in the directory. Mountview Apartments: 1977 in listings, 1974 in the directory. Neither year is settled here — use the strata documents, not a listing headline, for building age.
This page's copy substantially overlaps its sibling page.
The page's zoning shorthand conflicts with its own feed.

A bus route moved one block inside this sub-area in 2026. BC Transit's changes effective January 4, 2026 shifted Route 57 Broadway's Carleton Street service one block east to McNaught Road, with new stops on McNaught and Acorn — a small change that matters to a senior who plans to stop driving.

The eastern edge of an urban sub-area runs into farm rules. Agriculture is 67% of the City's land base, and any parcel here that turns out to be in the ALR follows the ALC housing frame — a 500 m² cap on a principal residence built without an application, and one additional residence at 90 m² or 186 m² depending on parcel size — not the City suite rules a buyer may be expecting.

faq.q: What 55+ homes can I actually BUY in Chilliwack Proper East?
faq.a: One verified age-restricted strata building: Mountainview Estates (46966 Yale Rd — listings record 55+, no pets; a directory records age restrictions in its bylaws; built 1989 in listings / 1988 in the directory, conflict flagged). A second building on Margaret Avenue is a flagged conflict only and is not counted — see the next question.

faq.q: Is Mountview Apartments the same building as Mountainview Estates?
faq.a: No — they are two different buildings with near-identical names, both labelled Chilliwack Proper East: Mountainview Estates at 46966 Yale Rd, and Mountview Apartments at 46374 Margaret Ave. Listings call the Margaret Avenue building a 55+ community and a directory records age restrictions, but no registered bylaws or Form B were checked for it, so it is not verified as 55+ in this file. Confirm from the strata documents before treating it as a 55+ purchase.

faq.q: Are pets allowed at Mountainview Estates?
faq.a: Listings record no pets for this building. Pet rules remain a valid bylaw matter, building by building — confirm against the registered bylaws and Form B for the specific unit.

faq.q: Can a detached house here take a suite or a coach house for a caregiver or family?
faq.a: One accessory dwelling unit per lot where the zone permits it — a secondary suite (capped at the lesser of 90 m² and 40% of the building's habitable floor space), a coach house, or a garden suite (capped at 100 m²) — under Zoning Bylaw 2020, No. 5000, ss. 2 and 4.06; a suite must be built with a permit meeting the BC Building and Fire Code and flood protection requirements, and new suites are not permitted below the flood construction level.

faq.q: If I need help later, can I stay in this part of Chilliwack?
faq.a: The assisted-living option at this scope's western edge is The Cascades (45586 McIntosh Dr, registered assisted living, class SN — boundary flagged in); the fuller ladder — the three Chartwell retirement residences, Jubilee Place subsidized rental and Chilliwack General Hospital at 45600 Menholm Rd — sits on the west / downtown side of the city-proper, a short move from Proper East rather than inside it.

faq.q: Why are there no market numbers for this area?
faq.a: Chilliwack is a CADREB market that SnapStats does not cover, and CADREB publishes statistics board-wide only with no sub-area tables — so any Chilliwack Proper East statistic is UNVERIFIED here rather than borrowed from a neighbouring board.

faq.q: When are Chilliwack property taxes due, and what is the penalty?
faq.a: Notices are mailed at the end of May and taxes are due the first working day after July 1 each year; for 2026, a 5% penalty applies to taxes outstanding after July 2, 2026 and an additional 5% to taxes outstanding after August 4, 2026.
